versions.content: Definition of API function SchM_Deinit Service Name SchM_Deinit Syntax void SchM_Deinit ( void ) Service ID [hex] 0x01 Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Non Reentrant Parameters (in) None Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value None Description SchM_Deinit is used to finalize Basic Software Scheduler part of the RTE of the core on which it is called. This service releases all system resources allocated by the Basic Software Scheduler part on that core. Available via Rte_Main.h
